en-US.description: Capture a screenshot, add your comments, and rearrange the layout. Give AI your complete visual feedback in one go.
en-US.longDescription:
When working on an interface with AI, you may know exactly what you want to change, yet spend a lot of words explaining where the change belongs and how much it should affect. EditHere puts that feedback directly on the image: capture a screenshot, mark a region and leave a comment, or drag and resize parts of the image to show the layout you have in mind. Then give AI the original image, annotations, and position and size changes in one go so it can continue editing your project with that context.
It suits web and app interfaces, game HUDs, charts, and other visuals where you need to show exactly what to change and where. EditHere itself calls no model and edits no code: it exports or copies annotated images and structured JSON, keeps projects so you can return to them later, and integrates with AI workflows through its companion skill and the edithere-cli command-line tool.
en-US.releaseNotes:
Windows installed and portable builds support free project update signatures. After verification, choose “Update now” in Settings → About and updates. Download integrity checks, unsaved-edit confirmation, installer readiness handoff and failure recovery remain in place.
Versions 0.12.7 and earlier need one manual installer upgrade from this repository’s release page. Older clients do not contain the new trust key and cannot authenticate the first migration; the upgraded client can authenticate later signed updates. A release without a matching signature or compatible installer remains available through the manual release-page download.
Project signatures authenticate project update packages; they are not publicly trusted Windows code-signing certificates. Unknown Publisher and SmartScreen warnings may remain. No system security checks need to be disabled.

zh-CN.description: 截图、写下意见、直接调整布局，把修改意图一次交给 AI。
zh-CN.longDescription:
和 AI 一起改界面时，想法很清楚，却常常要花很多文字解释位置与范围。EditHere 让你截图后直接在画面上圈出区域、写下意见，也可以把图像里的组件拖到想要的位置、调整到合适的大小，再把原图、批注以及位置和尺寸变化一次交给 AI，让它结合你的项目继续修改。它适合网页与应用界面、游戏 HUD、数据图表等需要具体指出“改哪里、怎么改”的场景。
EditHere 本身不调用模型或修改代码：可以导出或复制带批注的图片与结构化 JSON，保存项目之后接着修改；也可以通过配套 skill 和命令行工具 edithere-cli 接入 AI 工作流，由 AI 打开图片等你标注，收到反馈后继续执行修改。
zh-CN.name: EditHere · 改这里
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
Windows 安装版和免安装版支持免费的项目更新签名：验证通过后可在「设置 → 关于与更新」选择「立即更新」。保留下载完整性校验、未保存编辑确认、安装器准备就绪交接及失败恢复。
0.12.7 及更早版本请先从本仓库发布页手动下载安装一次。 旧程序没有新的内置信任公钥，不能自行信任首次迁移；此后可验证后续签名更新。新版缺少匹配签名或安装包时，仍提供发布页手动下载。
项目更新签名用于确认安装包来自项目，不是 Windows 公开信任的代码签名证书。“未知发布者”和 SmartScreen 提示仍可能出现，不需要关闭系统安全检查。
